name: Energy and Water Data Disclosure for Local Law 84 2016 (Data for Calendar Year 2015)
description:
This dataset contains energy and water use disclosures for New York City buildings subject to Local Law 84, covering calendar year 2015. Each row represents a property and includes identifying details such as property name, address, borough, building identification number, and coordinates, along with building characteristics like year built, number of buildings, occupancy, and primary property type.

The core of the data is energy and water performance: site and source energy use intensity, weather-normalized values, Energy Star scores and certification, fuel-specific consumption (natural gas, fuel oils, diesel, kerosene, propane, district steam and chilled water), electricity purchased and generated, green power, and greenhouse gas emissions (direct, indirect, and total). Water metrics include total, indoor, and outdoor use and intensity. Many columns capture property-use-specific details for categories such as offices, hospitals, hotels, multifamily housing, retail, restaurants, schools, data centers, and warehouses, plus data quality flags and alerts.
